Assessment of BA.evidence_source: Participants completed the Body Appreciation Scale (Avalos et al., 2005), a 13-item measure of related aspects of positive body image.

Assessment of BMI.evidence_source: Participants provided their demographic details consisting of sex, age, ethnicity, height, and weight. The latter two variables were used to compute participants' BMI.
